messages:
maria.g: heads up — small logistics update for Terrace eve booth. courier now says 16:35 ETA. can we commit two people at dock for 16:45 handoff?

jess: I can do 16:30-17:30. bringing HDMI + DP dongles + label printer.

leo: i'll be there 16:40. security needs a name drop: "Redwood Team" and our temp code 8842.

ops-bot: Venue note: loading dock D allowed for small vans. No pallets before 09:00. Contact: marco@terracevenue.com

priya: swag inventory arriving today: 150 shirts, 2k stickers, 60 plush. manifest: https://drive.example/manifest_terrace

maria.g: thanks. can marketing sign-off on the public benchmark stat for lightning talk? we said "70% latency reduction" earlier — need final approval.

samira: approved for public: "~70% latency reduction (customer averages)". include footnote: internal case study. I'll prep slide copy.

jess: lightning slot confirmed 18:15, 8 min. who will do slides? i'll run AV check at 17:50.

maria.g: i'll put together 5 slides: problem, numbers, demo, CTA (QR), contact. need QR URL final.

leo: final QR -> https://redwood.ai/terrace?utm_source=terrace&utm_campaign=q3field&utm_medium=booth&shift=evening

samira: backend note: QR must include 'shift' param or we'll lose segmentation. endpoint will tag leads with source:terrace; campaign:q3field.

maria.g: lead flow: scan -> webhook -> triage: interest:enterprise -> AE queue, interest:product -> nurture. test dry run at 17:05?

jess: yes i'll run dry run. davidh can you monitor AE queue?

davidh: on it. will be online 17:00-18:30.

maria.g: final: teardown plan pickup at 20:30 or office shipment next day if overweight. pinning to runbook. :thumbsup:
